server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Writes ServerName in PalWorldSettings.ini so the server browser and direct-join details show this instance name.

server_description.title: Server Description
server_description.description: Writes ServerDescription in PalWorldSettings.ini; players see it in the server details surface when Palworld exposes the description.

max_players.title: Max Players
max_players.description: Writes ServerPlayerMaxNum in PalWorldSettings.ini and passes -players at launch, controlling the join cap for this instance.

server_password.title: Server Password
server_password.description: Writes ServerPassword in PalWorldSettings.ini; leave blank for an open server or set it to require a join password.

admin_password.title: Admin Password
admin_password.description: Writes AdminPassword in PalWorldSettings.ini for authenticated REST API player management, broadcasts, world saves, and shutdown. Keep it non-empty when RESTAPIEnabled is true.

community_server.title: Community Server
community_server.description: Adds the official -publiclobby launch flag so the server can publish itself as a discoverable community room.

public_ip.title: Public IP
public_ip.description: Advertised WAN address for community server discovery. Leave blank when the host can resolve its own public address.

public_port.title: Public Port
public_port.description: Advertised WAN port for community discovery. This should match your forwarded game port.

region.title: Region
region.description: Writes Region in PalWorldSettings.ini for the advertised server region. Leave blank to let Palworld use its default behavior.

crossplay_platforms.title: Crossplay Platforms
crossplay_platforms.description: Comma-separated or one-per-line platform identifiers. LanGame renders them into the tuple syntax Palworld expects.

use_auth.title: Use Official Auth
use_auth.description: Keeps the official authentication flow enabled for public and cross-platform joins.

show_player_list.title: Show Player List
show_player_list.description: Writes bShowPlayerList in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling whether Palworld exposes the current player list when supported.

join_left_message.title: Join / Leave Feed
join_left_message.description: Shows the in-world join and leave messages that hosts use to confirm live player traffic.

enable_voice_chat.title: Enable Voice Chat
enable_voice_chat.description: Writes bEnableVoiceChat in PalWorldSettings.ini, enabling Palworld's in-game proximity voice chat.

voice_chat_max_volume_distance.title: Voice Chat Full-Volume Distance
voice_chat_max_volume_distance.description: Writes VoiceChatMaxVolumeDistance in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting the distance where proximity voice remains at full volume.

voice_chat_zero_volume_distance.title: Voice Chat Cutoff Distance
voice_chat_zero_volume_distance.description: Writes VoiceChatZeroVolumeDistance in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting the distance where proximity voice becomes inaudible.

allow_client_mod.title: Allow Client Mods
allow_client_mod.description: Allows players with client-side mods enabled to join. This does not install or deploy server-side mods for you.

mod_package_names.title: Active Mod Packages
mod_package_names.description: One Palworld Workshop PackageName per line from each staged mod's Info.json. LanGame writes these entries to Mods/PalModSettings.ini as ActiveModList.

use_backup_save_data.title: Built-in Rolling Backup
use_backup_save_data.description: Palworld's own save backup rotation inside the world save directory. This is separate from LanGame's managed backups.

log_format.title: Log Format
log_format.description: Controls both LogFormatType in PalWorldSettings.ini and the -logformat launch argument.

rcon_enabled.title: Enable RCON
rcon_enabled.description: Writes the native RCONEnabled option for external RCON clients. Palworld has deprecated RCON; LanGame uses the REST API for server management.

rest_api_enabled.title: Enable REST API
rest_api_enabled.description: Writes RESTAPIEnabled to enable authenticated player management, broadcasts, world saves, and graceful shutdown on the instance REST API port.

ban_list_url.title: Ban List URL
ban_list_url.description: Remote text file consumed by Palworld for ban synchronization.

enable_fast_travel.title: Enable Fast Travel
enable_fast_travel.description: Writes bEnableFastTravel in PalWorldSettings.ini to allow or disable fast-travel points in this world.

enable_fast_travel_only_base_camp.title: Enable Fast Travel Only Base Camp
enable_fast_travel_only_base_camp.description: Writes bEnableFastTravelOnlyBaseCamp in PalWorldSettings.ini, restricting fast travel to base camps when enabled.

enable_invader_enemy.title: Enable Invader Enemy
enable_invader_enemy.description: Writes bEnableInvaderEnemy in PalWorldSettings.ini to control raid and invasion-style enemy events.

enable_predator_boss_pal.title: Enable Predator Boss Pals
enable_predator_boss_pal.description: Writes EnablePredatorBossPal in PalWorldSettings.ini to control predator boss Pal spawns.

build_area_limit.title: Build Area Limit
build_area_limit.description: Writes bBuildAreaLimit in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling whether Palworld enforces extra build-area restrictions.

exist_player_after_logout.title: Exist Player After Logout
exist_player_after_logout.description: Writes bExistPlayerAfterLogout in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling whether player bodies remain in the world after logout.

is_start_location_select_by_map.title: Is Start Location Select By Map
is_start_location_select_by_map.description: Writes bIsStartLocationSelectByMap in PalWorldSettings.ini, allowing new players to choose a start location from the map.

auto_reset_guild_no_online_players.title: Auto Reset Offline Guild Bases
auto_reset_guild_no_online_players.description: Deletes structures and working Pals after the configured offline window when no guild members return.

auto_reset_guild_time_no_online_players.title: Offline Reset Hours
auto_reset_guild_time_no_online_players.description: Writes AutoResetGuildTimeNoOnlinePlayers in PalWorldSettings.ini, the offline duration before eligible guild bases are reset.

allow_global_palbox_export.title: Allow Global Palbox Export
allow_global_palbox_export.description: Writes bAllowGlobalPalboxExport in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling whether players may export Pals through the global Palbox.

allow_global_palbox_import.title: Allow Global Palbox Import
allow_global_palbox_import.description: Writes bAllowGlobalPalboxImport in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling whether players may import Pals through the global Palbox.

allow_enhance_stat_health.title: Allow Enhance Stat Health
allow_enhance_stat_health.description: Writes bAllowEnhanceStat_Health in PalWorldSettings.ini, allowing health stat enhancement when the game mode supports it.

allow_enhance_stat_attack.title: Allow Enhance Stat Attack
allow_enhance_stat_attack.description: Writes bAllowEnhanceStat_Attack in PalWorldSettings.ini, allowing attack stat enhancement when the game mode supports it.

allow_enhance_stat_stamina.title: Allow Enhance Stat Stamina
allow_enhance_stat_stamina.description: Writes bAllowEnhanceStat_Stamina in PalWorldSettings.ini, allowing stamina stat enhancement when the game mode supports it.

allow_enhance_stat_weight.title: Allow Enhance Stat Weight
allow_enhance_stat_weight.description: Writes bAllowEnhanceStat_Weight in PalWorldSettings.ini, allowing carrying-weight stat enhancement when the game mode supports it.

allow_enhance_stat_work_speed.title: Allow Enhance Stat Work Speed
allow_enhance_stat_work_speed.description: Writes bAllowEnhanceStat_WorkSpeed in PalWorldSettings.ini, allowing work-speed stat enhancement when the game mode supports it.

hardcore.title: Hardcore
hardcore.description: Writes bHardcore in PalWorldSettings.ini, enabling Palworld hardcore behavior for this world when supported by the current server build.

character_recreate_in_hardcore.title: Allow Character Recreate In Hardcore
character_recreate_in_hardcore.description: Writes bCanRecreateCharacter in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling whether a player may recreate a character after hardcore loss.

randomizer_type.title: Pal Randomizer Mode
randomizer_type.description: None keeps vanilla spawns, Region randomizes within each area's range, and All fully randomizes the spawn table.

randomizer_seed.title: Pal Randomizer Seed
randomizer_seed.description: Explicit seed used when Pal spawn randomization is enabled.

is_randomizer_pal_level_random.title: Fully Randomize Wild Pal Levels
is_randomizer_pal_level_random.description: Writes bIsRandomizerPalLevelRandom in PalWorldSettings.ini, making wild Pal levels random when spawn randomization is enabled.

invisible_other_guild_base_camp_area_fx.title: Hide Other Guild Base Boundaries
invisible_other_guild_base_camp_area_fx.description: Hides the base-area range effect for bases outside the local player's guild. This does not hide base structures or map markers.

active_unko.title: Enable UNKO Drops
active_unko.description: Enables the native Unko_S and Unko_L creation check. The built-in ActiveUNKO feature flag and character-state conditions must also allow creation; this switch alone does not guarantee drops.

enable_aim_assist_pad.title: Controller Aim Assist
enable_aim_assist_pad.description: Writes bEnableAimAssistPad in PalWorldSettings.ini, enabling controller aim assist for clients when Palworld honors the setting.

enable_aim_assist_keyboard.title: Keyboard Aim Assist
enable_aim_assist_keyboard.description: Writes bEnableAimAssistKeyboard in PalWorldSettings.ini, enabling keyboard and mouse aim assist when Palworld honors the setting.

is_pvp.title: Enable PvP
is_pvp.description: Writes bIsPvP in PalWorldSettings.ini, switching the world into Palworld PvP rule handling.

enable_player_to_player_damage.title: Enable Direct Player Damage
enable_player_to_player_damage.description: Writes bEnablePlayerToPlayerDamage in PalWorldSettings.ini, allowing direct player-versus-player damage.

enable_friendly_fire.title: Friendly Fire
enable_friendly_fire.description: Writes bEnableFriendlyFire in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling damage between allies or guildmates where Palworld applies friendly-fire rules.

can_pickup_other_guild_death_penalty_dro.title: Allow Picking Up Other Guild Death Drops
can_pickup_other_guild_death_penalty_dro.description: Writes bCanPickupOtherGuildDeathPenaltyDrop in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling whether other guilds can pick up death-penalty drops.

death_penalty.title: Death Penalty
death_penalty.description: Writes DeathPenalty in PalWorldSettings.ini, selecting which inventory, equipment, and Pal losses happen on player death.

pal_lost.title: Lose Team Pals On Death
pal_lost.description: Writes bPalLost in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling whether team Pals are lost as part of death penalties.

block_respawn_time.title: Respawn Cooldown Seconds
block_respawn_time.description: Writes BlockRespawnTime in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting the respawn cooldown before a player may re-enter after death.

respawn_penalty_duration_threshold.title: Respawn Penalty Survival Threshold (Seconds)
respawn_penalty_duration_threshold.description: Survival-time threshold used to apply the respawn cooldown multiplier on a subsequent death.

respawn_penalty_time_scale.title: Respawn Penalty Time Scale
respawn_penalty_time_scale.description: Writes RespawnPenaltyTimeScale in PalWorldSettings.ini, multiplying the respawn penalty duration when the threshold applies.

display_pvp_item_num_on_world_map_base_c.title: Show PvP Base Items On Map
display_pvp_item_num_on_world_map_base_c.description: Writes bDisplayPvPItemNumOnWorldMap_BaseCamp in PalWorldSettings.ini, showing PvP-related base item counts on the world map.

display_pvp_item_num_on_world_map_player.title: Show PvP Player Items On Map
display_pvp_item_num_on_world_map_player.description: Writes bDisplayPvPItemNumOnWorldMap_Player in PalWorldSettings.ini, showing PvP-related player item counts on the world map.

additional_drop_item_when_player_killing.title: Drop Bonus Item On PvP Kill
additional_drop_item_when_player_killing.description: Writes bAdditionalDropItemWhenPlayerKillingInPvPMode in PalWorldSettings.ini, enabling bonus drops for PvP kills.

additional_drop_item_when_player_killing.title: PvP Kill Bonus Item ID
additional_drop_item_when_player_killing.description: Writes AdditionalDropItemWhenPlayerKillingInPvPMode in PalWorldSettings.ini, the item ID granted by the PvP kill bonus rule.

additional_drop_item_num_when_player_kil.title: PvP Kill Bonus Item Count
additional_drop_item_num_when_player_kil.description: Writes AdditionalDropItemNumWhenPlayerKillingInPvPMode in PalWorldSettings.ini, the quantity granted by the PvP kill bonus rule.

day_time_speed_rate.title: Day Time Speed Rate
day_time_speed_rate.description: Writes DayTimeSpeedRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling how fast daytime passes in the world.

night_time_speed_rate.title: Night Time Speed Rate
night_time_speed_rate.description: Writes NightTimeSpeedRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling how fast nighttime passes in the world.

exp_rate.title: Exp Rate
exp_rate.description: Writes ExpRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling experience gain for players and progression systems.

pal_capture_rate.title: Pal Capture Rate
pal_capture_rate.description: Writes PalCaptureRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling the chance of successfully capturing Pals.

pal_spawn_num_rate.title: Pal Spawn Number Rate
pal_spawn_num_rate.description: Writes PalSpawnNumRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling wild Pal spawn density and related simulation load.

work_speed_rate.title: Work Speed Rate
work_speed_rate.description: Writes WorkSpeedRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling work performed by Pals and related base labor systems.

monster_farm_action_speed_rate.title: Ranch Production Speed Rate
monster_farm_action_speed_rate.description: Writes MonsterFarmActionSpeedRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling item production by Pals assigned to grazing facilities.

collection_drop_rate.title: Collection Drop Rate
collection_drop_rate.description: Writes CollectionDropRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling resources gained from gathering nodes.

collection_object_hp_rate.title: Collection Object HP Rate
collection_object_hp_rate.description: Writes CollectionObjectHpRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling hit points for gatherable objects.

collection_object_respawn_speed_rate.title: Gatherable Respawn Interval Multiplier
collection_object_respawn_speed_rate.description: Adjust the interval before gatherable objects respawn.

enemy_drop_item_rate.title: Enemy Drop Item Rate
enemy_drop_item_rate.description: Writes EnemyDropItemRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling item drops from enemies.

build_object_hp_rate.title: Building HP Rate
build_object_hp_rate.description: Writes BuildObjectHpRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling hit points for player-built structures.

build_object_damage_rate.title: Build Object Damage Rate
build_object_damage_rate.description: Writes BuildObjectDamageRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling damage dealt to build objects.

build_object_deterioration_damage_rate.title: Build Object Deterioration Damage Rate
build_object_deterioration_damage_rate.description: Writes BuildObjectDeteriorationDamageRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling structure deterioration damage over time.

player_damage_rate_attack.title: Player Damage Rate Attack
player_damage_rate_attack.description: Writes PlayerDamageRateAttack in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling damage dealt by players.

player_damage_rate_defense.title: Player Damage Rate Defense
player_damage_rate_defense.description: Writes PlayerDamageRateDefense in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling damage received by players.

player_stomach_decreace_rate.title: Player Stomach Decrease Rate
player_stomach_decreace_rate.description: Writes PlayerStomachDecreaceRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling player hunger drain.

player_stamina_decreace_rate.title: Player Stamina Decrease Rate
player_stamina_decreace_rate.description: Writes PlayerStaminaDecreaceRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling player stamina consumption.

player_auto_hp_regene_rate.title: Player Auto HP Regen Rate
player_auto_hp_regene_rate.description: Writes PlayerAutoHPRegeneRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling player natural health regeneration.

player_auto_hp_regene_rate_in_sleep.title: Player HP Regen In Sleep
player_auto_hp_regene_rate_in_sleep.description: Writes PlayerAutoHpRegeneRateInSleep in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling player health regeneration while sleeping.

pal_damage_rate_attack.title: Pal Damage Rate Attack
pal_damage_rate_attack.description: Writes PalDamageRateAttack in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling damage dealt by Pals.

pal_damage_rate_defense.title: Pal Damage Rate Defense
pal_damage_rate_defense.description: Writes PalDamageRateDefense in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling damage received by Pals.

pal_stomach_decreace_rate.title: Pal Stomach Decrease Rate
pal_stomach_decreace_rate.description: Writes PalStomachDecreaceRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling Pal hunger drain.

pal_stamina_decreace_rate.title: Pal Stamina Decrease Rate
pal_stamina_decreace_rate.description: Writes PalStaminaDecreaceRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling Pal stamina consumption.

pal_auto_hp_regene_rate.title: Pal Auto HP Regen Rate
pal_auto_hp_regene_rate.description: Writes PalAutoHPRegeneRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling Pal natural health regeneration.

pal_auto_hp_regene_rate_in_sleep.title: Pal HP Regen In Palbox
pal_auto_hp_regene_rate_in_sleep.description: Writes PalAutoHpRegeneRateInSleep in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling Pal health regeneration while resting in the Palbox.

pal_egg_default_hatching_time.title: Huge Egg Hatch Time (Hours)
pal_egg_default_hatching_time.description: Writes PalEggDefaultHatchingTime in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting huge egg hatch time in hours.

item_weight_rate.title: Item Weight Rate
item_weight_rate.description: Writes ItemWeightRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling item weight for inventory and encumbrance calculations.

equipment_durability_damage_rate.title: Equipment Durability Damage Rate
equipment_durability_damage_rate.description: Writes EquipmentDurabilityDamageRate in PalWorldSettings.ini, scaling durability loss for equipment.

item_corruption_multiplier.title: Item Spoilage Speed Multiplier
item_corruption_multiplier.description: Scale the rate at which perishable items spoil.

deny_technology_list.title: Disabled Technologies
deny_technology_list.description: Comma-separated or one-per-line technology IDs. LanGame renders them into Palworld's tuple syntax.

supply_drop_span.title: Meteorite / Supply Drop Interval (Minutes)
supply_drop_span.description: Minutes between meteorite or supply drop events.

base_camp_max_num.title: World Base Cap
base_camp_max_num.description: Writes BaseCampMaxNum in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting the total base cap for the world.

base_camp_max_num_in_guild.title: Bases Per Guild
base_camp_max_num_in_guild.description: Official 0.7.x limit setting. Pocketpair notes that raising it increases processing load.

base_camp_worker_max_num.title: Pals Per Base
base_camp_worker_max_num.description: Per-base worker cap. Pocketpair documents 50 as the hard maximum.

guild_player_max_num.title: Players Per Guild
guild_player_max_num.description: Writes GuildPlayerMaxNum in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting the maximum number of players in one guild.

guild_rejoin_cooldown_minutes.title: Guild Rejoin Cooldown (Minutes)
guild_rejoin_cooldown_minutes.description: Writes GuildRejoinCooldownMinutes in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting the cooldown before a player may rejoin a guild.

auto_transfer_master_check_interval_seco.title: Guild Master Transfer Check Interval
auto_transfer_master_check_interval_seco.description: Writes AutoTransferMasterCheckIntervalSeconds in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling how often inactive guild leadership is evaluated.

auto_transfer_master_threshold_days.title: Guild Master Inactivity Threshold
auto_transfer_master_threshold_days.description: Writes AutoTransferMasterThresholdDays in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting how many inactive days trigger guild leadership transfer.

max_guilds_per_frame.title: Guilds Processed Per Frame
max_guilds_per_frame.description: Writes MaxGuildsPerFrame in PalWorldSettings.ini, limiting guild maintenance work processed in one server frame.

max_building_limit_num.title: Buildings Per Base (MaxBuildingLimitNum)
max_building_limit_num.description: Limits the building count in the base containing the placement location. Set to 0 for no limit. The per-player building limit is checked separately.

server_replicate_pawn_cull_distance.title: Pal Replication Distance (Centimeters)
server_replicate_pawn_cull_distance.description: Pal synchronization distance from players, from 5000 to 15000 centimeters.

chat_post_limit_per_minute.title: Chat Limit Per Minute
chat_post_limit_per_minute.description: Writes ChatPostLimitPerMinute in PalWorldSettings.ini, limiting how many chat messages a player can post per minute.

item_container_force_mark_dirty_interval.title: Container Re-sync Interval (Seconds)
item_container_force_mark_dirty_interval.description: Writes ItemContainerForceMarkDirtyInterval in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling container re-sync cadence.

player_data_pal_storage_update_check_tic.title: Pal Storage Update Check Interval
player_data_pal_storage_update_check_tic.description: Writes PlayerDataPalStorageUpdateCheckTickInterval in PalWorldSettings.ini, controlling the player Pal-storage update check cadence.

drop_item_alive_max_hours.title: Dropped Item Lifetime (Hours)
drop_item_alive_max_hours.description: Writes DropItemAliveMaxHours in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting how long dropped items remain in the world.

drop_item_max_num.title: Dropped Item Cap
drop_item_max_num.description: Writes DropItemMaxNum in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting the normal dropped-item cap before cleanup pressure begins.

physics_active_drop_item_max_num.title: Physics-Active Drop Cap
physics_active_drop_item_max_num.description: Writes PhysicsActiveDropItemMaxNum in PalWorldSettings.ini, capping dropped items that keep active physics simulation; -1 leaves the cap disabled.

drop_item_max_num_unko.title: UNKO Drop Count Limit
drop_item_max_num_unko.description: Count limit for the native UNKO drop category. This is a separate category limit from the overall dropped-item count.

launch_perf_threads.title: Use Performance Thread Flags
launch_perf_threads.description: Adds -useperfthreads, -NoAsyncLoadingThread, and -UseMultithreadForDS. Palworld 1.0 recommends leaving these unset unless host testing shows a benefit.

launch_worker_threads_enabled.title: Set Explicit Worker Thread Count
launch_worker_threads_enabled.description: Controls whether LanGame appends -NumberOfWorkerThreadsServer at launch; it is only meaningful with the optional multithread flags enabled.

worker_thread_count.title: Worker Thread Count
worker_thread_count.description: Value passed through -NumberOfWorkerThreadsServer when explicit worker threads and the optional multithread flags are enabled.

fishing_difficulty_rate.title: Fishing Difficulty
fishing_difficulty_rate.description: Set fishing difficulty from 0.1 to 1.0, or leave blank to use the game's default.

enemy_camp_spawn_near_base.title: Enemy Camps Near Bases
enemy_camp_spawn_near_base.description: Choose whether enemy camps may spawn near player bases, or keep the game's default behavior.

gamedata_api_enabled.title: Game Data API
gamedata_api_enabled.description: Enable the game data API when an administration tool requires it.

enable_building_player_uid_display.title: Show Structure Creator
enable_building_player_uid_display.description: Writes bEnableBuildingPlayerUIdDisplay in PalWorldSettings.ini, showing the creator's player identity on structures.

building_name_display_cache_ttl_seconds.title: Structure Creator Cache TTL
building_name_display_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Writes BuildingNameDisplayCacheTTLSeconds in PalWorldSettings.ini, setting the creator-name cache lifetime used by structure identity display.

max_building_limit_num_per_player.title: Buildings Per Player (MaxBuildingLimitNumPerPlayer)
max_building_limit_num_per_player.description: Limits the building count attributed to the player creating the structure, including pending building reservations. Set to 0 for no limit. The per-base building limit is checked separately.
